lore: Jin Kazama is the heir of the Mishima Zaibatsu and the Kazama family. He fights to control the Devil Gene within him.
Claudio Serafino is a secret society exorcist who fights using solar magic and elegant martial arts.
Sergei Dragunov is a stoic soldier of Spetsnaz, hunting targets with precision and relentless force.
Victor Chevalier is a cunning fighter with a dark past, excelling in heavy damage and strategy.
Lars Alexandersson is a rogue rebel leader, agile and unpredictable, fighting for freedom.
